ITEM 1 | Corn cob rounds, three pieces (two whole-ish rounds and one half at right edge), bright yellow kernels with pale cream centers, cut crosswise into discs about 4-5 cm across and 2-3 cm thick, dry matte surface with slight sheen, sitting on right side of plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Cubes of firm pale off-white block (tofu-like), about 2-3 cm pieces, matte surface with slightly porous texture, some edges lightly golden-browned, holding shape, clustered center-right of plate | 85
ITEM 3 | Zucchini or squash slices, pale green skin with darker green edges, cut into half-moon wedges about 5-6 cm long and 1.5 cm thick, lightly charred/grill-marked on cut faces, slightly glossy, left-center of plate | 60
ITEM 4 | Thin green beans, bright to dark green, about 8-10 cm long, slender, slightly wilted with some darker blistered spots, lying in a bundle on left side of plate | 35
ITEM 5 | Fresh spinach leaves, dark green, glossy and wilted, medium-sized leaves about 6-8 cm, clustered center-right, some with visible veins, slightly moist | 20
ITEM 6 | Cherry tomato halves and whole, bright red with glossy skin, about 2-2.5 cm diameter, one whole and fragments visible among spinach, juicy-looking | 15
ITEM 7 | Small scattered pale crumbs and seed-like specks, tan to cream colored, dry, scattered around left-center near green beans and tofu edges | 3
